finding.expected: Resolve the current canonical correction state using the existing correction/review lineage authority and fail closed when the selected finding is already resolved, superseded, or otherwise no longer outstanding. Add focused regression evidence for the resolved-finding case without introducing a second lifecycle reducer.
finding.issue: AUTHOR_REMEDIATION does not enforce the TASK-104 requirement to reject an already-resolved finding before mutation. After detecting that canonical main descends past review.reviewed_sha, the implementation contains only a placeholder pass and proceeds to create the remediation ref. This leaves the correction frontier capable of accepting stale semantic authorization after the finding has already been resolved by later canonical lineage.

original_constraints: Existing Runtime transport, Unified State, correction preflight, semantic review, publication, and historical artifact interpretation remain behaviorally compatible. No second lifecycle reducer, Reviewer, publication authority, correction frontier, or generic repository writer is introduced.
Do not push from Executor implementation execution.
